label: Programme Zero — Rex Autistikon (Kim 2026), the first filled template
note: Metadata only: bridge names, ledger and register counts, a locked-array size, a stop rule. No chapters, no measured array, no scores. The grant object is illustrative of the shape, not a real license.

fields.label: Rex Autistikon corpus (Programme Zero, first corpus)
anti_overreach: no individual-level score on the eight-interface construct
no clinical, diagnostic or therapeutic claim
listening material is not an intervention
predictive-coding language is inert scaffolding, not an engine
no derived index or assessment instrument

fields.label: Tissue mechanics literature
anti_overreach: no inference from a tissue measurement to a person's traits
no clinical claim from bench mechanics

bridges.junction: which mechanical quantities may stand beside which descriptive terms, and under what reliability — two vocabularies that do not share units

register.consequence: retire the bridge; record the failed junction
amend the ledger rating to contested; re-run the pre-registered check
drop the item from the locked array by amendment
stop the programme early under the stop rule

stop.rule: if no register entry survives two pre-registered replications, abandon; the clock runs whatever the results look like

license_grant.grantor: the author of the volume's prose (Kim), at arm's length
